issue.title: Consultation bundle omits the bed-matrix lookup needed for its open-ward admission choice
issue.actual: The current consultation bundle's endpoints and checklist do not list GET /beds/matrix, although POST /admissions supports requested_ward_id. The backend handoff for #38 says admission forms should offer only the matrix's wards. The endpoint works for demo.doctor; the frontend now uses the real matrix for this optional preference.
issue.expected: Include GET /beds/matrix in consultation's endpoint/handbook dependencies (and the admission ward-choice instruction) so agents following its bundle can discover the authorized open-ward list without an admin-only ward lookup or guessed identifiers.
issue.steps: On knowledge fingerprint5f8bd8feecd1d68f7841 read get_screen_bundle('consultation', sections=['endpoints','definition_of_done','handbook']). It omits GET /beds/matrix. Read get_endpoint GET /beds/matrix and call it as demo.doctor; it succeeds.
